content.short: Loop Crypto is the only protocol that enables true autopay, with no locking up funds and no withdrawals, ever.
content.description: Loop Crypto delivers what many Web3 teams need: the most effective way to accept crypto payments and, uniquely, the only protocol that enables true autopay—there are no funds locked and no withdrawals ever. With Loop, users retain control of their assets while recurring payments are automated without requiring signatures for each transaction. If you’re a Web3 company, or you serve Web3 companies, DAOs, or communities, automation isn’t optional—it's essential to streamline payments and scale engagement.
